source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
State- why the test failed 3 put in the certificate number on repairs # When a test fails 1. Go to your EICR e.g. excel spreadsheet 2. Open the form 3. Search for the certificate number 4. Return to the failed test reading and insert The certificate number and the reason for a fail into the comment box 5. Save and close. # Note 1. The test records may be sent for review 2. Each appliance must have a separate form 3. Upon completion of each appliances safety check, the repairer will send back a copy of the completed form for your records 4. At the time of documenting the fail, a new certificate number is added for evidence purposes
